acceptance_criteria: Mapping matrix produced using EmpresaID and empresa_id

queries.name: api_local_dual_empresa_columns
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 100 CONVERT(nvarchar(100), id) AS connection_id, nombre, system_type, tipo_conexion, activo, visible_en_operaciones, visible_en_listado, [empresa_id] AS empresa_id_text, [EmpresaID] AS EmpresaID_int FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones WHERE tipo_conexion = 'API_LOCAL' ORDER BY nombre

queries.name: api_local_mapping_via_sistema_empresas_servidores
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(nvarchar(100), sc.id) AS connection_id, sc.nombre, sc.system_type, sc.tipo_conexion, sc.activo AS conexion_activa, sc.visible_en_operaciones, sc.visible_en_listado, sc.[empresa_id] AS empresa_id_text, sc.[EmpresaID] AS EmpresaID_int, ses.EmpresaID AS mapped_EmpresaID, se.CodigoEmpresa, se.NombreEmpresa, se.NombreComercial, se.Activo AS empresa_activa, ses.RolConexion, ses.NombreSucursalSistema, ses.EsPrincipal, ses.Activo AS mapping_activo FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones sc LEFT JOIN dbo.Sistema_EmpresasServidores ses ON ses.ServidorID = sc.id LEFT JOIN dbo.Sistema_Empresas se ON se.EmpresaID = ses.EmpresaID WHERE sc.tipo_conexion = 'API_LOCAL' ORDER BY sc.nombre, ses.Activo DESC, ses.EsPrincipal DESC, ses.EmpresaID

queries.name: api_local_mapping_cardinality
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(nvarchar(100), sc.id) AS connection_id, sc.nombre, sc.[EmpresaID] AS current_EmpresaID_int, sc.[empresa_id] AS current_empresa_id_text, COUNT(ses.EmpresaServidorID) AS mappings_total, SUM(CASE WHEN ses.Activo = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mappings_activos, SUM(CASE WHEN ses.Activo = 1 AND ses.EsPrincipal = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mappings_activos_principales, MAX(CASE WHEN ses.Activo = 1 AND ses.EsPrincipal = 1 THEN ses.EmpresaID END) AS candidate_principal_EmpresaID, MAX(CASE WHEN ses.Activo = 1 THEN ses.EmpresaID END) AS candidate_any_active_EmpresaID, CASE WHEN sc.[EmpresaID] IS NOT NULL THEN 'ALREADY_HAS_EMPRESAID' WHEN COUNT(ses.EmpresaServidorID) = 0 THEN 'NO_MAPPING_FOUND' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ses.Activo = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 'ONLY_INACTIVE_MAPPINGS' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ses.Activo = 1 AND ses.EsPrincipal = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'CANDIDATE_FROM_ACTIVE_PRIMARY_MAPPING' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ses.Activo = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'CANDIDATE_FROM_SINGLE_ACTIVE_MAPPING' ELSE 'AMBIGUOUS_MULTIPLE_ACTIVE_MAPPINGS' END AS mapping_verdict FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones sc LEFT JOIN dbo.Sistema_EmpresasServidores ses ON ses.ServidorID = sc.id WHERE sc.tipo_conexion = 'API_LOCAL' GROUP BY sc.id, sc.nombre, sc.[EmpresaID], sc.[empresa_id] ORDER BY sc.nombre

queries.name: sistema_empresas_active_catalog
queries.sql: SELECT EmpresaID, CodigoEmpresa, NombreEmpresa, NombreComercial, RFC, Activo FROM dbo.Sistema_Empresas ORDER BY EmpresaID

queries.name: ricardo_scope_probe
queries.sql: SELECT u.UsuarioID, u.Email, u.Activo AS usuario_activo, ue.EmpresaID AS empresa_asignada, ue.Activo AS empresa_asignacion_activa, urc.EmpresaID AS empresa_contexto_rol, urc.RolID, urc.Activo AS rol_contexto_activo FROM dbo.Usuario_Catalogo u LEFT JOIN dbo.Usuario_EmpresasAsignacion ue ON ue.UsuarioID = u.UsuarioID LEFT JOIN dbo.Usuario_RolesContexto urc ON urc.UsuarioID = u.UsuarioID WHERE u.UsuarioID = 8 OR u.Email = 'ricardo@edarsa.com.mx' ORDER BY ue.EmpresaID, urc.EmpresaID, urc.RolID

objective: Build READ_ONLY mapping matrix for API_LOCAL connections using both dbo.Servidores_Conexiones.EmpresaID and dbo.Servidores_Conexiones.empresa_id, then compare against Sistema_EmpresasServidores and Sistema_Empresas. No DML.
